Friends of Strays is a non-profit organization founded in 1978 in St. Petersburg, FL, dedicated to the care and adoption of homeless pets.
We believe that love saves lives – and it takes everyone to make that work happen. As a nonprofit, we rely on the generosity of our community to save the lives of more than 4,000 cats and dogs each year, giving them the refuge, care, and love they deserve. Every animal who comes in our door is treated as an individual, with their own needs and preferences. Through our adoption and trap-neuter-vaccinate-return programs, we seek to humanely reduce the number of homeless animals Pinellas County, Tampa Bay, and the state of Florida.
